design_condition: The compact cubic volume extends the existing school area and adapts to difficult terrain through a rear garden-level entrance and a slight embankment affecting only secondary ground-floor areas.

positive.statement: The simple cubic body fits very well into the available space and continues the language and geometry of the existing centers.
The difficult terrain situation is cleverly used by offsetting the main entrance and exit to the rear garden area around a floor.
The generous, calm and protected outdoor area is a quality of the chosen solution.
The various areas are of good spatial quality and functionally arranged.
The different niches and views into the corridor zones support privacy and help functionality.
The functionality and quality of the spatial offer are maintained in their flexibility towards changes in use.
The central open staircase, decentralized lifts and escape stairs provide visible and functional access.

negative.statement: The orientation of the parking lot, school garden and playground leads to problems with solar exposure and accessibility.
The two ground-floor height offsets are problematic for the offices, meeting rooms and gymnasium.
The location of the therapy rooms on the upper floor is deficient.
The facade design appears arbitrary and monotonous and does not coherently convey the system and its function.
The skeleton construction still has several inconsistencies.
The climbing zones and wet cells are not consistently stacked.
The project requires a noise barrier along the highway to meet noise protection requirements.
